source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the alpine and sub-alpine meadows, printed page 243.

blocks.text: Yeh bohat oonchai par "thande registan" (cold deserts) ya ghaas ke maidan (grasslands) hain, jahan aab-o-hawa itni sakht hai ke bare darakht nahin ug sakte.

items: Location (jagah): Gilgit-Baltistan, Chitral, Swat, Azad Jammu & Kashmir ki pahari chotiyan aur Deosai Plains (Deosai ke maidan).
Abiotic Profile: Temperature (darja hararat): shadeed sardi; salana ausat darja hararat 1°C se 10°C. Water (paani): zyada tar bhaari barf ki shakal mein (6 feet tak).
Key Flora (ahem paude): Thingne (stunted, chhote reh jane wale) junipers, bhoj (Birch, Betula utilis), bed (willow) aur mukhtalif alpine ghaas aur jangli phool.

Key Fauna (ahem janwar): Snow leopard (barfani cheeta), Himalayan brown bear (bhoora reechh), Himalayan Ibex, musk deer (kastoori hiran) aur marmots. Snowcock, monal aur golden eagle jaise parinde bhi yahan milte hain.

Current Status (maujooda haalat): Fragile (nazuk). Yeh ilaqe global warming se bohat jaldi mutasir hote hain, kyun ke pighalti barf ki chotiyan (snow caps) charagah (meadow) ke nazuk tawazun ko badal deti hain.

blocks.alt: Barfeeli chotiyon ke neeche oonchi charagah; chhote conifer sirf door neechi dhalwanon par. Labels: bari chattan par snow leopard, bil ke paas marmots, pathreeli dhalwan par Himalayan ibex, charta hua Himalayan brown bear, neechi thingni (stunted) junipers aur bohat se jangli phool.

blocks.prompt: Alpine aur sub-alpine meadows ka ek paudha aur ek janwar batayein.
blocks.explanation: Maslan thingne junipers (ya Betula utilis) aur snow leopard (ya Himalayan Ibex).

items: Oonchai par thande registan ya ghaas ke maidan; bare darakht nahin ugte.
Jagah: Gilgit-Baltistan, Chitral, Swat, AJK ki chotiyan, Deosai; 1°C-10°C, 6 feet tak barf.
Paude: junipers, birch, willow, alpine ghaas; janwar: snow leopard, brown bear, ibex, musk deer, marmots. Haalat: fragile.
